mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (primary_key, report_date, enterprise_code, creator, remark, status, finished_product, finish_num, scrap_num, main_id, receive_num, receive_user_code_list, inspect_type, procedure_code_list) values (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.reportDate}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.creator}, #{data.remark}, #{data.status}, #{data.finishedProduct}, #{data.finishNum}, #{data.scrapNum}, #{data.mainId}, #{data.receiveNum}, #{data.receiveUserCodeList}, #{data.inspectType}, #{data.procedureCodeList})
mapper.select: WITH a as (SELECT COUNT(1) as num FROM (SELECT creator, main_id, status FROM ${reportTableName} where main_id = #{mainId} and status = 50 and delete_flag = FALSE GROUP BY creator, main_id, status)), b as (SELECT COUNT(1) as num FROM (select "operator", main_id, status from ${dispatchTableName} WHERE main_id = #{mainId} and delete_flag = FALSE and status not in (10, 20) GROUP BY "operator", main_id, status)) select a.num = b.num from a, b
